question: What was total revenue last month?
Compare revenue by region for Q1 vs Q2

description: Sales revenue metrics with customer segmentation

content: When calculating revenue, use the Revenue measure from mv_sales_revenue.
When asked about 'last month', use the previous calendar month (not the last 30 days).
Round all monetary values to 2 decimal places.
When asked about 'top customers', order by Revenue descending.

question: Show top 10 customers by revenue
sql:
SELECT `Customer Segment`, `Region`,
  MEASURE(`Revenue`) AS revenue,
  MEASURE(`Order Count`) AS order_count,
  MEASURE(`Average Order Value`) AS aov
FROM sales.semantic.mv_sales_revenue
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
